aspects.label: Aspect of Disobedience
aspects.labelTemplate: You gain {value}% increased Armor for 4 seconds when you deal any form of damage, stacking up to 44%.

aspects.label: Aspect of Might
aspects.labelTemplate: Basic Skills grant {value}% Damage Reduction for 2 seconds.

aspects.label: Conceited Aspect
aspects.labelTemplate: Deal {value}% increased damage while you have a Barrier active.

aspects.label: Eluding Aspect
aspects.labelTemplate: Becoming Injured while Crowd Controlled grants you Unstoppable for {value} seconds.

aspects.label: Aspect of the Elements
aspects.labelTemplate: Gain {value}% increased damage to a set of damage types for 7 seconds. This effect alternates between Fire, Ice, and Lightning damage types.

aspects.label: Aspect of Frozen Orbit
aspects.labelTemplate: Blizzard deals {value}% increased damage and will strike 1 additional time.

aspects.label: Snowguard's Aspect
aspects.labelTemplate: While within your own Blizzard, you take {value}% less damage.

aspects.label: Prodigy's Aspect
aspects.labelTemplate: Using a Cooldown restores {value} Mana.

aspects.label: Aspect of Piercing Cold
aspects.labelTemplate: Ice Shards pierce {value} times, dealing 20% reduced damage each pierce.

aspects.label: Flamethrower Aspect
aspects.labelTemplate: Incinerate forks into {value} additional streams.

aspects.label: Aspect of Berserk Ripping
aspects.labelTemplate: Whenever you deal direct damage while Berserking, inflict {value}% of the Base damage dealt as additional Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

aspects.label: Aspect of Anemia
aspects.labelTemplate: Lucky Hit: Direct damage against Bleeding enemies has up to a {value}% chance to Stun them for 2 seconds.

aspects.label: Aspect of Grasping Veins
aspects.labelTemplate: Gain {value}% increased Critical Strike Chance for 6 seconds when you cast Corpse Tendrils.

aspects.label: Blood Seeker's Aspect
aspects.labelTemplate: Blood Lance deals {value}% increased damage to its primary target for each other enemy it also hits.

aspects.label: Aspect of Explosive Verve
aspects.labelTemplate: Your Grenade skills count as Trap skills. Whenever you arm a Trap or drop Grenades, you gain {value}% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

aspects.label: Rapid Aspect
aspects.labelTemplate: Basic Skills gain {value}% increased Attack Speed.

aspects.label: Aspect of the Unsatiated
aspects.labelTemplate: After killing an enemy with Shred, your next Werewolf Skill deals {value}% increased damage.

aspects.label: Stormshifter's Aspect
aspects.labelTemplate: While Hurricane is active, Shred gains {value} additional Charge(s).

aspects.label: Aspect of the Calm Breeze
aspects.labelTemplate: Lucky Hit: Wind Shear has up to a {value}% chance to fully restore your Spirit.

aspects.label: Aspect of the Overflowing Energy
aspects.labelTemplate: Crackling Energy hits {value} additional enemy. Each time Crackling Energy hits an enemy, your Shock Skill Cooldowns are reduced by 0.1 second.
